clauses.quote: teachers shall not, under normal conditions, be assigned outside the scope of their teaching licenses and endorsements.
District seniority of teachers shall be considered for purposes of school, schedule, program, grade level, or year round track assignments.
All regular contract teachers at a school site shall have the opportunity to apply for reassignment to any available position at the school site, prior to the position being filled (through June 1).
clauses.subject_text: All regular contract teachers at a school site

clauses.quote: Changes in teaching assignments during the school year should be avoided.
clauses.subject_text: Changes in teaching assignments during the school year

clauses.quote: Enrollment changes or other unforeseen circumstances may, however, make it necessary for the principal to make changes in teaching assignments during the year.
clauses.subject_text: Enrollment changes or other unforeseen circumstances

clauses.quote: Teachers shall report, in writing as soon as possible to their principal /supervisor, any assault suffered in connection with their employment.
The principal/supervisor will forward a copy to School Accountability Services.
The Superintendent and a law enforcement agency shall be notified of any such assault.
clauses.subject_text: The Superintendent and a law enforcement agency

clauses.quote: If criminal or civil proceedings are brought against a teacher, alleging that he or she committed an assault in connection with his or her employment, such teacher, after making the reports described in Article 13.1 above, may request the Board to furnish legal counsel to defend him/ her in such proceedings, insofar as the interest of the teacher and the District are not conflicting.
If the teacher is found guilty or liable in such proceedings, such finding shall constitute a cause for dismissal from the school system.
Fines, damages, penalties, or forfeitures shall not be paid by the Board.
